neighbours.label: Next-word prediction of an online-service category: fires on the word just before 'streaming / dating / sharing / networking / messaging / social media …' ('a [dating] app', 'video [sharing] site', 'various [social media] platforms'); the output direction promotes exactly those words
fire: Millions of people now listen to music on a streaming service instead of buying albums.
My cousin met her husband on a dating site while she was living abroad.
The clip spread quickly across several social media platforms overnight.
He uploads his travel footage to a popular video sharing site every week.
Teenagers spend hours each day chatting on instant messaging apps.
The company runs a professional networking site for engineers.
Drivers who sign up for the ride sharing app can choose their own hours.
She keeps her holiday pictures on a photo sharing service.
quiet: Millions of people now listen to music on a kitchen radio instead of buying albums.
My cousin met her husband at a wedding reception while she was living abroad.
The rumor spread quickly across several mountain villages overnight.
He sends his travel footage to a local film club every week.
Teenagers spend hours each day chatting on park benches.
The company runs a small training center for engineers.
Drivers who sign up for the night shift can choose their own routes.
She keeps her holiday pictures in a leather album.

notes: Card: ' social', ' a', ' the', ' video', ' various', ' online' before 'streaming platform', 'social bookmarking service', 'video sharing websites'; the + pole's output suppresses ' messaging', ' dating', ' streaming', ' sharing', ' networking', so this pole promotes them. Probes: 0.32-0.75 on such sentences; 'on a small television' 0.15, 'through a mutual friend' 0.21 (near misses leak a little at ' a').
